# Performance Optimization Best Practices

## Purpose

Improve application performance and resource efficiency.

## Instructions

- Profile and benchmark critical code paths.
- Minimize allocations and avoid unnecessary object creation.
- Use caching where appropriate.
- Optimize database queries and use indexes.
- Monitor and log performance metrics.

## References

- See README.md for performance monitoring tools.
  - Compliance with all best practices above
